title: Skills and workflows
sub: The second film of Agents at work on data, a series on putting AI agents to work on data: a skill is a playbook, earned by doing a job once by hand and refined at every new case, so nothing is solved twice; a router picks the right skill; and a workflow runs the known steps the same way every time, calling the agent only where thinking is needed.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool, a skill or a fixed step, violet the model, orange data coming back, green a check that passes, amber one that fails, or a loop. The scenes of Baghdad are painted full-frame, matte and soft-lit, with the place and the time on a tag.
